plan.notes: UTK 2025-2026 undergraduate catalog, Mechanical Engineering Major (B.S.), Tickle College of Engineering. Catalog publishes a total of 130-131 hours; choice slots transcribed at the first-listed option (MATH 132 at 3 credits), giving 130. The catalog site renders a stale archived-catalog header label on this program page; the sequence content matches the current Volunteer Core curriculum and the college's official Mechanical Engineering Catalog 2025 curriculum sheet. Departmental electives: any 300-level or above aerospace, biomedical, or mechanical engineering courses not already required. Technical elective must be pre-approved and petitioned by the advisor and department head.
